changelog: Major UI improvements and refined Windows 11-inspired design.
Added CPU, GPU, RAM, and battery monitoring with hardware vendor detection.
Added battery health calculation and dynamic battery indicators.
Improved AMD and NVIDIA Tuning Center compatibility handling.
Added Fan Control and Windows High Performance GPU preference.
Improved RAM cleanup and application optimization modules.
Added customizable Acrylic blur intensity and performance settings.
Added optional UI animations and smooth scrolling.
Added Light Mode (Beta) and improved application settings.
Improved Quick Profiles and persistent toggle state synchronization.
Redesigned updater dialogs and release changelog interface.
Improved update installation reliability and SHA-256 verification.
Various bug fixes, UI refinements, and stability improvements.
